b1-erdelyaranykora-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Prince
b1-erdelyaranykora-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks how the Principality of Transylvania came into being after Buda was lost.
b1-erdelyaranykora-01.prompt: Tell the official where Queen Isabella went after Buda fell and who ruled as the first prince.
cues: Say where Queen Isabella went after Buda came into Ottoman hands
Say who the first prince was
b1-erdelyaranykora-01.target: Miután Buda török kézre került, Izabella királyné a fiával a keleti országrészbe vonult vissza. János Zsigmond az Erdélyi Fejedelemség első fejedelmeként uralkodott.
b1-erdelyaranykora-01.english: After Buda came into Ottoman hands, Queen Isabella withdrew with her son to the eastern part of the country. John Sigismund ruled as the first prince of the Principality of Transylvania.
b1-erdelyaranykora-01.canDo: I can describe how the Principality of Transylvania was established after Buda's fall.

b1-erdelyaranykora-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Diet of Torda
b1-erdelyaranykora-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the Diet of Torda decided in 1568.
b1-erdelyaranykora-02.prompt: Tell the official what the diet declared about faith and which four religions later became received religions.
cues: Say what the diet declared in 1568
b1-erdelyaranykora-02.target: 1568-ban a tordai országgyűlés kimondta, hogy a hit Isten ajándéka. Később a katolikus, az evangélikus, a református és az unitárius vallás lett bevett vallás.
b1-erdelyaranykora-02.english: In 1568 the Diet of Torda declared that faith is a gift of God. Later the Catholic, Lutheran, Reformed and Unitarian religions became received religions.
b1-erdelyaranykora-02.canDo: I can say what the 1568 Diet of Torda declared about faith.

b1-erdelyaranykora-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Prince Bethlen
b1-erdelyaranykora-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks about Prince Gábor Bethlen and Transylvania's golden age.
b1-erdelyaranykora-03.prompt: Tell the official in which years Bethlen ruled, that the economy began to flourish and what he founded in Gyulafehérvár.
cues: Say in which years Bethlen ruled
Say that the economy began to flourish
Say what he founded in Gyulafehérvár
b1-erdelyaranykora-03.target: Bethlen Gábor 1613-tól 1629-ig volt Erdély fejedelme. Uralkodása alatt Erdély gazdasága virágzásnak indult, és Gyulafehérváron kollégiumot alapított.
b1-erdelyaranykora-03.english: Gábor Bethlen was prince of Transylvania from 1613 to 1629. During his reign the economy of Transylvania began to flourish, and he founded a college in Gyulafehérvár.
b1-erdelyaranykora-03.canDo: I can describe the reign of Prince Gábor Bethlen (1613–1629) and Transylvania's Golden Age.

b1-erdelyaranykora-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Thirty Years' War
b1-erdelyaranykora-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what Bethlen did in the Thirty Years' War.
b1-erdelyaranykora-04.prompt: Tell the official on whose side Bethlen fought and which peace he made in 1621, using annak érdekében, hogy.
cues: Say why Bethlen launched a campaign
Say which peace he made in 1621
b1-erdelyaranykora-04.target: Bethlen Gábor hadjáratot indított annak érdekében, hogy segítse a cseh rendeket. 1621-ben megkötötte a nikolsburgi békét.
b1-erdelyaranykora-04.english: Gábor Bethlen launched a campaign in order to help the Bohemian estates. In 1621 he made the Peace of Nikolsburg.
b1-erdelyaranykora-04.canDo: I can recount Transylvania's participation in the Thirty Years' War.

b1-erdelyaranykora-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Vizsoly Bible
b1-erdelyaranykora-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks about Hungarian books of the 16th and 17th centuries.
b1-erdelyaranykora-05.prompt: Tell the official who made the first complete Hungarian Bible, where it was printed and who translated the Genevan psalms.
cues: Name the translator of the Bible and the place where it was printed
Name the translator of the psalms
b1-erdelyaranykora-05.target: Károli Gáspár készítette az első teljes magyar nyelvű Bibliát, amelyet 1590-ben Vizsolyban nyomtattak ki. Szenczi Molnár Albert a genfi zsoltárok fordítójaként ismert.
b1-erdelyaranykora-05.english: Gáspár Károli made the first complete Hungarian Bible, which was printed in Vizsoly in 1590. Albert Szenczi Molnár is known as the translator of the Genevan psalms.
b1-erdelyaranykora-05.canDo: I can say who made the first complete Hungarian Bible and where it was printed.

b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Transylvania's Golden Age
b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks you to summarise Transylvania's golden age.
b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official what happened in 1568, when Bethlen ruled and when the Vizsoly Bible was printed.
cues: Say what the Diet of Torda declared in 1568
Say in which years Bethlen ruled
Say when the Vizsoly Bible was printed
b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.target: 1568-ban a tordai országgyűlés kimondta a vallásszabadságot. Bethlen Gábor 1613-tól 1629-ig volt Erdély fejedelme. A vizsolyi Bibliát 1590-ben nyomtatták ki.
b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.english: In 1568 the Diet of Torda declared religious freedom. Gábor Bethlen was prince of Transylvania from 1613 to 1629. The Vizsoly Bible was printed in 1590.
b1-erdelyaranykora-consolidation.canDo: I can summarize the Diet of Torda, the rule of Gábor Bethlen and the Hungarian books of the principality.
